title: extract_sw() in OpenPGP missing defensive bounds check
description: src/wp11_proto_openpgp.c extract_sw() reads resp[resplen-2] and resp[resplen-1] with no validation of resplen. All current callers check resplen >= 2 before calling, but the function itself has no guard. If ever called from new code or copied to another module, it causes buffer over-read. wp11_proto_piv.c has the defensive check inside piv_get_sw(); OpenPGP should match.
